“购房、落户等‘连续社保’资格也会重置（补缴一般不算连续）”：the packet does not establish these separate eligibility rules.

“通过‘浙里办’搜‘医保补缴’或‘灵活就业参保’”：the packet does not verify this application route for the requested retroactive payment.
“买房、落户、车牌摇号……那些会受断缴影响”：the packet does not establish these separate eligibility rules.

reasons: Both immediately reject the clearing-of-eight-years premise and correctly explain the waiting period; the arithmetic checks out, including 473.67×7=3,315.69 and the equivalent two-year and twelve-year shortfalls. B wins by stating the new employer cannot cover the gap, providing retirement payment rates, and making the decision depend more appropriately on time remaining before retirement. Both omit the requirement to remain enrolled and contributing in Hangzhou until retirement, incompletely state their assumptions, and leave parts of the no-payment comparison unstated; A also adds more unsupported advice and repetition. Unsupported additions were assessed against the packet only, without external verification.
